title: stack
description: Several widgets sent as one: a scheduled report or brief with a header line (who and when), its widgets in order, in sections that fold, as rows, a carousel or a grid.

type.description: Any primitive except `stack`: a stack never holds a stack.

fallback_text.description: The child’s own fallback, ≤ 2,000 characters like any single widget.

items.description: A complete widget payload of another primitive, with its own `id`, `rev`, `as_of` and `fallback_text`. This schema checks the envelope (type, v, id, title, as_of, fallback_text and the shared fields) and refuses a nested stack; it can’t `$ref` every type by its `type` value, so the plugin validates each child against `<type>.schema.json` and the client does again when it draws it.

children.description: The widgets: each a complete payload of another primitive (never a stack), with its own `id`. The schema checks each child’s envelope; the plugin checks each against its own type schema. In the order they are read: what to do first, problems, today, then numbers. The client never reorders them.

layout.description: list: everything open. collapsed: one row per child, unfolded on tap (long reports); every child needs `summary` for its row. carousel: children of one type, swiped. grid: two columns on wide columns, a list on iPhone.

children.description: The ids of the children in this section, in order. They must follow one another in `children`.

folded.description: Start folded (the line with a chevron). The person’s unfold is kept on the device.

items.description: A labelled group of children that folds.

sections.description: Labelled groups for list, collapsed and grid. Children not in a section come first, unlabelled. Ignored by carousel.

label.description: How often, in words: “Daily at 07:00”, “Every weekday at 07:00”, “Mondays at 08:00”.

task.description: The id of the Hermes Task (the gateway’s cron job) that sends this report. The widget menu gets Open Task (Tasks → that task), where the person can change or pause it.

schedule.description: For a scheduled report: when it comes. Without a subtitle, the header says “<label> · <the as_of date>”.

tag.description: The small tag at the end of the header: Scheduled, Digest, Weekly. Defaults to Scheduled when `schedule` is set; none otherwise.
